user.title: Lotto 6/45 Analysis
user.description: Analyze Lotto 6/45 history using the release-bundled snapshot and a shared GitHub mirror, then create selectable recommendation games.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Lotto 6/45 Analysis instance can be configured.

init.title: Lotto 6/45 settings
init.description: Choose which settings to edit. Recommendation settings and personal Four Pillars data are separated so the Configure dialog remains compatible and reliable.

menu_options.recommendations: Recommendation methods, AI, and data source

recommendations.title: Recommendation methods, AI, and data source
recommendations.description: Select one or more methods. To enable Personal Four Pillars, first save the birth profile from the previous menu. Detailed explanations are available on the Recommendation Method Guide sensor.

data.ai_task_entity_id: AI Task entity (optional; blank uses the preferred data AI Task)
data.ai_auto_generate: Automatically generate AI recommendation for a new draw
data.allow_official_direct_fallback: Allow limited direct Donghaeng Lottery fallback

data_description.selected_methods: Multiple methods can be selected. Personal Four Pillars can only be enabled after the personal profile has been saved. None of these methods changes the mathematical winning probability.
data_description.enable_ai_recommendation: AI is independent from local methods. Manual Refresh / Regenerate does not regenerate the AI recommendation.
data_description.ai_auto_generate: Only generates AI automatically when a new official draw is detected. Manual local regeneration suppresses AI generation.
data_description.allow_official_direct_fallback: Only used when the shared mirror is unavailable. It can fetch at most a tiny recent gap, uses sequential rate-limited requests, and never crawls the full history. Keep this disabled unless needed.

saju.title: Personal Four Pillars profile
saju.description: Save personal birth information before using the Four Pillars recommendation. Enter the birth date as YYYY-MM-DD and birth time as HH:MM. Raw birth values remain in Home Assistant and are not sent to the lottery mirror or HA AI prompts.

data_description.saju_birth_time: Example: 14:30. Use the actual birth time when available.
data_description.saju_birth_place: Example: Seoul, South Korea. No external geocoding request is made.
data_description.saju_timezone: For births in Korea, Asia/Seoul is normally used.
data_description.saju_lunar_leap_month: Used only for lunar-calendar birth dates.
data_description.saju_true_solar_time: When enabled, the hour pillar time is corrected using timezone meridian, longitude and equation of time.
data_description.saju_longitude: Only needed when true solar time correction is enabled.

error.select_at_least_one: Select at least one recommendation method.
error.saju_profile_required: Save the Personal Four Pillars profile from the previous menu before enabling this recommendation method.
error.invalid_saju_profile: The Four Pillars profile is missing or invalid. Check all required birth fields.
error.options_error: An error occurred while processing the options. Check the entered values and try again.
